problem.statement: SIH26157: supervisors must assess many security operations centres periodically without re-examining every record by hand.

workflow: CSE submits periodic evidence (alerts, cases, investigation steps, escalations, dispositions, assets)
SAT-SA validates and normalizes it with per-record provenance
findings are fused into entity risk and supervisory priority
each finding shows the source records it cites
a human supervisor records the decision
TRUST-SAT signs and verifies the recorded state

controlled_experimental_evidence.claim: Validation matched its declared contract in 245/245 perturbed conditions
Evaluation found and fixed a real product defect (a withheld workflow finding)
TRUST-SAT detected all 13 tested mutations of the recorded state
36/36 injected interruptions recovered with identical outputs
LangGraph added a median 0.096 s per workflow on one machine (interval includes zero)
Ranking captured more pathological entities than random order in 20/20 generated populations; comparable to a closure-speed rule

external_data_evidence.claim: The unchanged pipeline processed a real public IT incident log: 134,888 rows accepted, 0 rejected, 50/50 groups analysed
external_data_evidence.category: independent feasibility validation (IT service management, not SOC)

external_data_evidence.claim: SAT-SA risk did not track SLA misses on that data; the diagnosed main cause is that SLA timeliness is a different construct (fast closure helps SLA but is a warning sign in SOC supervision)
external_data_evidence.category: negative independent evidence under domain mismatch

honest_limits_to_state: All SOC-shaped results are controlled synthetic; no real SOC data was evaluated.
A simple closure-speed rule performed comparably on generated populations; simple baselines tie the fast-closure detector on the closure corpus.
On a real IT incident log several detectors fired for every group and SAT-SA risk did not track SLA misses.
Stale and contradictory records are accepted without warning.
Human study: protocol ready, not executed. Expert labels: pipeline ready, no labelled data.
Containers, live PostgreSQL, S3 and hosted deployment are not verified.
